charge_and_shot.recharge_after_firing: Possible; pressing charge while firing adds to remaining charge.

wiki_explicit_notes: Short-range mode is available after only a little charge; first 21F charge yields 29F firing (10 short-range shots).
A 50F one-cycle charge yields 92F firing (10 short + 13 long shots).
After firing begins, the first 30F (0.5 seconds) are short-range; it then transitions to long-range over 10F and includes two mid-range transition shots.
Short-range duration remains 0.5 seconds regardless of charge; extra charge extends only long-range duration.

To extend shooting, press charge while firing; charging and firing both cross the mode threshold and can switch modes. Recharging above the highest stored charge raises the saved threshold; firing the charge away lowers it back toward neutral.
Wiki table reports no charge-dependent range change for a given firing mode.

wiki_explicit_notes: First 8F of first-cycle charge stores one uncharged-equivalent shot; the following 30F stores one additional 15-shot segment, for 38F total per first cycle.
Each later 38F cycle stores 15 shots; the page notes second-cycle efficiency is 30/38 (about 0.79) of the first cycle.
Charge-keep duration is 200F (3.333 seconds); partial charge can be kept.
Charge amount does not alter individual bullet range or speed; added charge mainly extends shot duration.

rangeUnitReference.wikiStatement: 射程・距離関係の単位は試し撃ちラインの本数。
rangeUnitReference.interpretation: Individual table cells normally omit an inline unit (inlineUnit is null); the shared Wiki rule defines range/distance rows in trial-range line counts. Velocity units DU/F are not used for these range fields.

rangeLabelCaveat: The individual tables do not expose a row literally named ダメージ減衰射程. Where present, the exact row 確定数維持射程 is preserved as its own metric; it is not relabeled as a damage-dropoff threshold. damageDropoffRange is null for every entry. Normalized fields use exact row-label matches only; absent labels remain null.
